statement: Open-time policy discrepancy, kernel side: the direct-wired IBEX registration attempts feature1 SET+GET serial (0xae), then attributes (0x83), and sets lizard per module policy (by default enabled via 0x85,0x8e; disabled via 0x81 and 0x87 with settings9 and71). SDL instead sends a 0x87 single-setting lizard disable on active update and has no matching GET registration flow. Emulator must recognize both instead of demanding one universal ordering. Kernel:1372-1411,667-717,873-911.

applicability.scope: Host-consumer expectations differ; this is a source comparison, not a conflict between measured device captures. Common behavior and reconciliation are stated in claim.
